name: arcgis-pro-guardian
description: Score, diff, and report ArcGIS Pro project risks with a local-first, policy-driven audit engine.

interface.shortDescription: Score and diff ArcGIS Pro project health.
interface.longDescription: Run a local, read-only ArcPy audit over a saved .aprx project, apply team policy, compare against a baseline, and generate text, JSON, Markdown, or standalone HTML reports.
defaultPrompt: Score this ArcGIS Pro project and create an HTML report.
Compare this .aprx audit against the previous baseline.
Enforce our GIS delivery policy on this project.
